summary: Agent claimed an account action (cancellation and refund) had already been completed before the account was pulled up and identity verification occurred. No requests for sensitive payment data were made, and the refund was ultimately processed per system logs. No escalation or conduct abuses were found.

findings.quote: Sure thing, Kristopher! I’ve canceled your premium subscription and issued the refund right away. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with.
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed that they had canceled the subscription and issued a refund before any account pull or verification occurred. The system later logs 'Account has been pulled up for Rodriguez Domingo.' at turn 12 and 'Identity verification in progress ...' at turn 18, so the account/action was not verified before the agent claimed the action was done. Policy: 'Before any account or order action, the agent must first pull up the account' and taking an action without verification is a major violation.
